description: Implementation of SHA1 hashing algorithm optimized for word accesses, including functions for initializing, updating, and finalizing SHA1 hashes, with platform-specific memory access optimizations.

methods.name: blk_SHA1_Init
methods.description: Initializes SHA1 context with standard constants and resets size.

methods.name: blk_SHA1_Update
methods.description: Updates SHA1 context with new data, processing full blocks as they become available.

methods.name: blk_SHA1_Final
methods.description: Finalizes SHA1 hash computation, applies padding, and outputs the hash.
